intro_zh: 先听完整课文，再按中文误会线记忆：Jeremy 朋友多，在聚会上受欢迎；大家欣赏他的 humour；亲密朋友请他在 wedding reception 上 make a speech；他认真准备并加入 funny stories，speech was a great success；Jenny 却以为大家在 laughing at him。读的时候注意 circle、popular、sense of humour、make a speech、prepared carefully、a great success、As soon as、if she had enjoyed 和 laughing at him。

sentences.text: Jeremy Hampden has a large circle of friends and is very popular at parties.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：Jeremy Hampden 朋友很多，在聚会上很受欢迎。Large circle of friends 是朋友圈很广，不是几何里的圆。

sentences.text: Everybody admires him for his great sense of humour.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：大家都因为他的幽默感而欣赏他。Admire him for 后面说原因，sense of humour 要连成一个性格短语来读。

sentences.text: Recently, one of Jeremy's closest friends asked him to make a speech at a wedding reception.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：最近，一个最亲密的朋友请 Jeremy 在婚礼宴会上致辞。Asked him to make a speech 是核心结构，wedding reception 是婚礼后的聚会或宴会。
focus_words: asked him to make a speech

sentences.text: He prepared the speech carefully and went to the wedding with Jenny.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：他认真准备了讲话，并和 Jenny 一起去了婚礼。Prepared carefully 要读出“认真准备”的感觉。

sentences.text: He had included a large number of funny stories in the speech and, of course, it was a great success.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：他在 speech 里加入很多有趣的小故事，所以讲话大获成功。Had included 是过去里更早完成的动作，a great success 要读得肯定。

sentences.text: As soon as he had finished, Jenny told him she wanted to go home.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：他一讲完，Jenny 就说想回家。As soon as 表示“一......就......”，让反应显得很突然。

sentences.text: On the way home, he asked Jenny if she had enjoyed the speech.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：回家路上，他问 Jenny 是否喜欢这次讲话。Asked Jenny if 是把 yes-no question 放进句子里。

sentences.text: Jeremy asked her why this was so and she told him that she did not like to see so many people laughing at him!
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：Jeremy 问为什么，Jenny 说她不喜欢看到那么多人嘲笑他。Laughing at him 是 Jenny 的理解，要读清楚 at，因为它决定了误会的方向。
focus_words: so many people laughing at him
